sources.source_name: UPI: Coca-Cola Earnings Rise in Fourth Quarter, Year
sources.notes: Contemporary year-end report: 1989 net income was $1.7 billion versus $1 billion in 1988; revenue was $9 billion versus $8.3 billion. It reports 1989 earnings per share of $4.92, including $1.47 per share from the November Columbia Pictures stock sale and 10 cents per share from the Belmont Springs sale; earnings per share excluding those gains were $3.35. The company described another year of record achievements for its global soft-drink business.

sources.source_name: Los Angeles Times: Coca-Cola Board OKs Sale of Columbia
sources.notes: Contemporary report on Coca-Cola selling its Columbia Pictures stake to Sony; Coke expected an after-tax gain of about $530 million.
